objective.title: Qualify conventioned exact and finite quantiles with paired covariance and Pearson correlation

declared.summary: Qualify Type-7 and nearest-rank sample quantiles over exact rationals and finite binary64, plus bounded centered covariance and Pearson correlation. Observe a compiled independent RED, pass 26 new GREEN and 71 total statistics tests with numeric/rational regressions, inspect local NuGet preview.3, and complete only M3-W02-C02-T1 plus R/G/V while leaving C02/T2 active for boundary qualification.
declared.value: Make quantile definitions, probability representation, exact-vs-approximate loss, covariance denominators and independent Pearson oracles explicit without provider, Decision or AURA coupling.
debtChanges: The Type-7 interpolation and nearest-rank conventions are explicit; no implicit distributional quantile or VaR estimator is inferred.
Rational quantiles use exact probabilities with 4096-bit and 4096-observation budgets. Finite quantiles remain lossy binary64.
Paired covariance uses population N and sample N-1, with a centered compensated Pearson normalization and a 4096-pair bound.
Constant/degenerate vectors refuse in T1; typed undefined correlation and complete missing/NaN/singleton policies belong to T2.
